## New Features

- Ask-in-passing narrators now start in read-only mode with a "Promote" button to unlock write access or fork a new working chapter
- Browser performance tracing: start/stop Chrome DevTools Protocol traces from AI tools, with live recording indicator in the session bar
- Event hook system: configure shell commands or HTTP webhooks that run before/after tool execution, with PreToolUse hooks able to block tool calls
- Skill enable/disable toggle: disable global skills without deleting them (SKILL.md renamed to SKILL.md.disabled)
- Windows PATH auto-refresh: reads current PATH from the registry at startup and on dependency recheck, so newly installed tools (e.g. git) are found without a reboot

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed full-text search message navigation losing highlight when redirecting through chapter pages
- Removed file:// protocol support in WebFetch/Browser to prevent bypassing Read tool path security checks
- Hook routes now require admin privileges, preventing non-admin users from creating hooks that execute arbitrary commands
- TaskOutput and Agent tools accept legacy parameter names (wait/timeout_ms, background) to avoid behavior reversal in existing conversations

## Improvements

- Plan mode soft-deny now asks the user once before auto-denying, with one-click relaxed plan mode activation
- Message stream rendering: atomic cache flush eliminates flicker when streaming messages arrive
- Provider disable state is now bidirectionally synced between provider records and the disabledProviders set
- Disabled providers' models are filtered from the visible model list
- Anthropic provider updated to match Claude Code CLI 2.1.88 request signature and beta flags
- Codex WebSocket now captures post-connection errors instead of silently dropping them
- Browser click action waits for navigation to settle before returning page snapshot
- Batch insert of narrator message refs chunked to stay within SQLite variable limit
- cleanHtml restored to sanitize-html library with expanded tag/attribute allowlist
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 顺便提问的叙述者默认为只读模式，提供「转正」按钮解锁写入权限或从当前章节分叉新工作章节
- 浏览器性能追踪：AI 工具可启停 Chrome DevTools Protocol trace，会话栏实时显示录制状态
- 事件钩子系统：配置在工具执行前后运行的 Shell 命令或 HTTP Webhook，PreToolUse 钩子可阻止工具调用
- 技能启用/禁用切换：无需删除即可禁用全局技能（文件重命名为 SKILL.md.disabled）
- Windows PATH 自动刷新：启动时和依赖检查时从注册表读取最新 PATH，新安装的工具（如 git）无需重启即可识别

## 修复

- 修复全文搜索消息跳转经章节页面重定向后丢失高亮的问题
- 移除 WebFetch/Browser 的 file:// 协议支持，防止绕过 Read 工具的路径安全检查
- Hook 路由添加管理员权限要求，防止普通用户创建可执行任意命令的钩子
- TaskOutput 和 Agent 工具兼容旧参数名（wait/timeout_ms、background），避免已有对话行为反转

## 改进

- 计划模式软拒绝优化：首次触发时询问用户，允许后一键开启宽松规划模式
- 消息流渲染：原子性缓存刷新消除流式消息到达时的闪烁
- Provider 禁用状态在 provider 记录和 disabledProviders 集合间双向同步
- 已禁用 provider 的模型从可见模型列表中过滤
- Anthropic provider 更新至 Claude Code CLI 2.1.88 请求签名和 beta flags
- Codex WebSocket 改为捕获连接后错误，不再静默丢弃
- 浏览器 click 操作等待导航完成后再返回页面快照
- 叙述者消息引用批量插入分块处理，避免超出 SQLite 变量数限制
- cleanHtml 恢复使用 sanitize-html 库，扩展标签和属性白名单
